concepts.name: 双向流量 B
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: desktop app icon for Bandix, software for network traffic monitoring, bandwidth limits, device usage and live upload/download charts.
Primary request: integrate the brand initial B and the meaning of network traffic monitoring into ONE distinctive visual symbol. The network motif must be structurally part of the B, not an extra badge or generic symbol placed next to a letter.
Exactly one centered icon on a square canvas, a deep midnight navy rounded-square tile occupying 88% of the canvas, with genuinely transparent outer margin. Minimal confident vector-like geometric branding, thick strokes, spacious negative shapes, readable at 24–32 px. Modern refined finish with only subtle tonal depth, no glass and no excessive 3D effects. Crisp clean edges.
Text: only a custom B monogram; no written word Bandix, no captions.
Avoid: mockups, grids, multiple icons, decorative particles, floating pixels, tiny circuitry, tiny graph ticks, external shadows, watermark.
Subject: an unmistakable uppercase B formed by two broad interlocking directional paths. A continuous bright cyan lower loop flows downward and a warm orange upper loop flows upward, meeting a strong shared vertical spine at the left. Each path ends in one large integrated arrowhead on its curved right edge, the direction indicators follow the path rather than being separate vertical arrows. The overall silhouette must remain a balanced rounded B with TWO large open counters. The cyan and orange represent download and upload. Keep arrowheads simple, avoid overly knotted overlap. Striking memorable compact logo.
